title: Warehouse Team Leader (f/m/d)
description:
You lead a team in the goods-receipt area of our logistics centre.

What you'll do
- Lead 18 employees, plan shifts and deployment
- Monitor throughput and error rates
- Help introduce new processes

What you bring
- Experience as a team leader or shift leader in a warehouse
- Good English skills for working with international colleagues
- Knowledge of SAP EWM or a comparable system
